answer.event_detail: The robot turned the stove knob but did not complete the rotation to the 'on' position.
answer.evidence: At t=14.4s, the wrist camera shows the robot's gripper engaging with the front-left burner knob. At t=16.0s, the wrist camera shows the knob has been rotated approximately 90 degrees (from vertical to horizontal), but the indicator (or the knob's position relative to the dial markings) suggests it is not fully in the 'on' position (which typically requires a full 180-degree turn or a specific click). The robot arm is still positioned over the knob, indicating the action was interrupted or incomplete.
